children: HCW Biologics entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with an existing institutional investor to raise approximately $1.5 million through the sale of 903,614 units at $1.6599 per unit. Each unit includes a pre-funded warrant exercisable at $0.0001 per share and the right to receive a common warrant exercisable at $1.66 per share upon stockholder approval. The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable with a 9.99% ownership cap; the common warrants will be immediately exercisable upon issuance, carry a 5.5-year term, and include a 4.99% ownership cap. Proceeds will support working capital and clinical development.
